column3: A compaction role in owner.defaults, tried before utility for compaction summaries; no title role
column4: Compaction is the one routine call per long conversation, and a cheap summarizer is a cost win distinct from the memory pass. Absent compaction keeps the old order, so stored owner.defaults rows need no migration. Nothing generates titles, so a title role would have no consumer
column5: plugins/compact/compact.test.ts: the compaction model summarizes ahead of the utility model; the test fails with compaction dropped from the order
